entry.summary:

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 10,620Chapters: 4/8Kudos: 64

Summary: “Not guilty,” Merlin spits out. “That wasn’t even magic.”“The smoke looked like a cat!” Uther protests. “Like a cat sitting down, which is a relatively nondescript shape!”“So you admit it looked like a cat!”“Only vaguely. God, not everything is sorcery, you stupid arrogant old coot!”The court gasps. Gaius looks like he wants to melt into the floor. Gwaine looks five seconds away from bursting into laughter, which will likely get him banished again. Lance also looks like he wants to laugh, but only because Merlin knows what to look for. “That’s treason, boy,” Uther spits back. “And so is magic. God, make up your mind on what reason you’ve decided on for executing.”“I SAW YOU!” Uther roars. “You were smiling at the smoke! You were making a mockery of Sir Ulfius’ funeral!”---After Merlin gets accused of having magic for stupid reasons, he decides to take matters into his own hands. Arthur is going to have the worst week of his life, but Uther will be having a worse one. After all, doesn't that bastard deserve a little magical chaos in his kingdom? Basically, Merlin decides to go a little crazy and haunt Uther specifically.

entry.title: Reign of Bloody Time
entry.summary:
Author: BadAshWolf

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 16,400Chapters: 9/20Kudos: 37

Summary: For years, he carved lines into the earth and runes into his own skin. Now, it is time to crack both open and drag the future back to his King. But, as warned in the days of old, nothing is brought back without a cost. He is a king-maker who has outlived his sovereign; a warlock who has finally stopped bartering with words and started bartering with existence. He will pay any price if it means his heart never goes where he cannot follow him again. Merlin burrows to a past that hasn't yet bled, and is no longer the bumbling servant Camelot remembers. He is something older, hungrier, and powerful beyond measure. This time, Arthur will not just wear a crown; Merlin will carve him into a god to match his own dark divinity. And if it takes a little blood to bind them together, to ensure what he is owed, who he earned, then Merlin will gladly teach his prince how to thirst for it. A long time-travel fix-it, a terrible and magnificent Merlin, an Arthur remade, and the breathless cost of devotion.
